req.title: Register rejects duplicate username
req.statement: The system shall render an error message when POST /auth/register is called with a username already present in the users table.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject duplicate usernames during registration. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_register_new_user
preconditions: The database is initialized with predefined users.
actions: Attempt to register a new user with a unique username.
expected: The registration should succeed, redirecting to the login page.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
app.app_context().push()

# Initialize the database
from flaskr.db import init_db
init_db()

# Positive test: Register a new user
r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'newuser', 'password': 'newpass'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_register_duplicate_user
preconditions: The database is initialized with predefined users.
actions: Attempt to register a user with an existing username.
expected: The registration should fail with an error message indicating the username is already registered.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
app.app_context().push()

# Initialize the database
from flaskr.db import init_db
init_db()

# Negative test: Register with an existing username
r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'newpass'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'User Rahul is already registered.' in r.data

tests.name: test_register_empty_username
preconditions: The database is initialized with predefined users.
actions: Attempt to register a user with an empty username.
expected: The registration should fail with an error message indicating that the username is required.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
app.app_context().push()

# Initialize the database
from flaskr.db import init_db
init_db()

# Boundary test: Register with an empty username
r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': '', 'password': 'newpass'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Username is required.' in r.data
